content: As mentioned in the introduction, our approach is based on the idea of zero-shot MT BIBREF11 . There the authors show that after training a single model to translate from Portuguese to English as well as from English to Spanish, it can also translate Portuguese into Spanish, without seeing any translation examples for this language pair. We use the zero-shot effect to achieve monolingual translation by training the model on bilingual examples in both directions, and then doing translation into the same language as the input: illustrated on Figure FIGREF1 .
